title: AT Protocol OAuth Client Metadata
description: JSON Schema for ATProto OAuth Client Metadata Documents (RFC 7591 / ATProto OAuth specification).

client_id.description: HTTPS URL where this client metadata document is hosted.

logo_uri.description: URL of the application logo image.

tos_uri.description: URL of the application terms of service.

policy_uri.description: URL of the application privacy policy.

scope.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes requested by client (e.g. 'atproto').

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: Requested authentication method for token endpoint. ATProto OAuth profile: shared-secret methods (client_secret_basic/post) are not part of the protocol; confidential clients use private_key_jwt.

dpop_bound_access_tokens.description: Indicates whether client requires DPoP-bound access tokens.

jwks_uri.description: URL for the client's JSON Web Key Set.
